node.doctext: Thank you very much! The loop wasn't working for me, so I had assumed that it was a coding difference between libraries. However, following your advice, I went back and double checked, and I had made the smallest mistake. Thanks again for your help, and sorry if this post was inappropriate: you guys have helped me so much and I wouldn't want to annoy any of you!
